Lacey and Dakota were absolutely amazing! From start to finish, they were professional, thorough, and incredibly knowledgeable. Dakota quickly identified the issue with our pool, explained everything clearly, and fixed it efficiently. We haven’t had a single problem since their repair, and the whole experience was seamless.

It’s rare to find a company that genuinely cares about the quality of their work, but Evolution Leak Detection truly does. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
Evolution was recommended thru moms of allen fb group 😁, super happy about the networking to find Evolution Leak Detection & Pool Repair

Dakota and Lacey are on top of things- communication, replies, service, knowledge, delivery! It is difficult to find just the right company to take care of important pool services and offer competitive prices-ELD&PR met all expectations

They diagnosed our issues and followed plan to repair multiple problems

100% satisfied and recommend to other pool owners- Evolution Leak Detection & Pool Repair, so glad they helped out our family!
reviews.author: brian flowers

reviews.text:
I didn’t end up using this business for paid services but I felt truly compelled to leave a review because of the incredible kindness and care shown to me by Dakota and Lacey.

I’m in town visiting my dad for Christmas from UT Austin. Late at night, when I had an issue with my spare tire, a man from this family-owned business immediately helped me. He noticed my spare was dangerously low on air, and took the time to fill it up. He and his wife were both there and treated me with such warmth and generosity.

They filled my spare, checked the air levels in all of my tires filling them up as needed. They let me know honestly that another tire was getting thin to make sure that I was aware and I should get it replaced soon, and even checked my oil just to make sure everything was okay. This was all out of genuine concern. They went above and beyond to help me during the holidays in kindness I never expected and I am incredibly grateful.

This is a small family-owned business that truly cares about people, despite being strangers, not just transactions. If you’re looking for a business run by genuinely good, compassionate people who treat others with kindness and integrity, I can’t recommend them enough. I will never forget how they treated me. Dakota and Lacey will no longer be strangers to me but rather people who earnestly care about the other people within the community.
reviews.author: Raquel Palacios

reviews.text: I highly recommend this family-owned company run by Dakota and his wife Lacey. They are both very professional and took the time to explain everything to us and reassure us about the work needed to fix the leaks in our pool. Dakota didn't hesitate to dive into 50-degree water to check all the pipes.  The follow-up on the quotes and scheduling of appointments was very efficient thanks to Lacey, who knew just what to say to convince us to proceed with the repairs. We can't wait for the work to be completed.
reviews.author: Philippe Wagner

reviews.text: Dakota did an awesome job at getting our pool leaks repaired. Evolution was recommended by our weekly pool cleaning service and they were quick to diagnose the issue and offer a solution to the multiple leaks we had from our pool settling over the past few years. The leaks were repaired about a month ago and I haven’t had to refill the pool yet! 🙌  Dakota and Lacey are extremely professional and were very helpful with any questions I had! They explained everything that needed to be done and provided a reasonable price for everything!
reviews.author: Jillian Behmanesh

reviews.text:
WOW! Talk about exceptional service!

Let’s face it, most pool companies don’t exactly have a reputation for stellar customer service—especially after the big freeze of 2021 left so many of us pool owners scrambling for repairs. But Evolution Leak Detection completely changed my expectations.

I started noticing I had to fill up my pool every other day—a clear sign something was wrong. Suspecting a leak, I reached out to my regular pool service company for help. They referred me to another company, but after multiple calls and an online form submission, I got… crickets.

Frustrated, I turned to Google and searched for pool leak detection companies in McKinney. That’s when I found Evolution Leak Detection, and I’m so glad I did! I submitted an online form, and Lacey called me back right away. She listened to my concerns, quickly scheduled a visit, and had Dakota, their leak detection specialist, at my house within the same week.

Sure enough, Dakota confirmed my suspicion: there was a leak. Lacey then provided me with a repair quote that was much more reasonable than I expected. She even got me scheduled for repairs without any hassle. Dakota came back, fixed the leaks, and sent me photos of the completed work to show exactly what they did.

Let’s be honest—dealing with pool leaks is a headache no one wants. But if you’re in that boat, do yourself a favor and call Lacey and Dakota at Evolution Leak Detection. They made the whole process easy, professional, and surprisingly pleasant. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Nick Good

reviews.text: Spectacular experience!  Doug, Dakota, and Lacey were all wonderful!  They detected all the issues with our pool and worked with us on a plan to fix everything.  Highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: Michael Lube

reviews.text: Dakota and his wife Lacey, make a fantastic team. Communication was excellent from the initial contact through the quote and invoicing process. They’re honest, professional, and deliver high-quality work. I would highly recommend them for any pool-related services
reviews.author: David White

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic and reflect a well-regarded, family-owned business. The consistent praise for owners Dakota and Lacey, coupled with specific service details and lack of complaints, strongly indicates genuine customer satisfaction. The minor clustering of owner mentions is more likely due to strong personal branding than fake reviews.
fake_signals: Multiple reviews mention the same two owners (Dakota and Lacey) in very similar positive terms, which could indicate solicitation or a strong branding focus.

positive_evidence: Reviews mention lasting repairs (e.g., 'haven’t had to refill the pool yet', 'haven’t had a single problem since their repair').

authentic_signals: Reviews contain specific project details (e.g., 'dive into 50-degree water', 'multiple leaks from pool settling', 'had to fill pool every other day').
Varied writing styles and lengths, from brief recommendations to detailed narratives.
Mentions of third-party referrals (e.g., 'recommended thru moms of allen fb group', 'referred by our weekly pool cleaning service').
One review details a non-service-related act of kindness (helping with a spare tire), adding credibility.
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent and high across Google (4.9) and Yelp (4.6). BBB is not rated but has no complaints, which aligns with positive feedback elsewhere.
